# BreatheWay — Hyperlocal Clean Air Telemetry & Exposure Management Platform

> Hyperlocal multi-pollutant telemetry, GenAI routine optimization, and low-exposure transit routing for resilient urban living. Built for PromptWars Challenge 6 with EPA breakpoints and zero-trust architecture.

## Overview

BreatheWay is an enterprise-grade urban environmental intelligence platform designed to translate granular municipal sensor telemetry into actionable daily personal exposure decisions. The platform combines real-time multi-pollutant dispersion tracking, atmospheric thermal inversion detection, Dijkstra-optimized low-exposure transit corridors, CADR-based indoor air quality calculation, and AI-powered schedule optimization.

### Core Capabilities
- **Hyperlocal Air Telemetry**: Real-time multi-pollutant monitoring (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3, CO, SO2) with microclimate tracking across five distinct municipal monitoring sectors.
- **Interactive Smog Heatmap**: High-fidelity spatial visualization with isopleth contours, wind vector plumes, and interactive sector telemetry cards.
- **GenAI Routine Optimizer**: Deterministic meteorological forecasts combined with Google Gemini 3.1 neural recommendations for outdoor activity planning.
- **Low-Exposure Transit Corridors**: Multimodal Dijkstra routing engine comparing respiratory intake dose across walking, cycling, transit, and driving.
- **Indoor Air Quality (IAQ) Center**: Clean Air Delivery Rate (CADR) calculation, ACH estimation, and an inversion-aware window ventilation schedule.
- **Community Smog Abatement Hub**: Collective emission reduction pledges and emergency smog broadcast alerts.
